Run a Production or inspect its diagnostics

Usage: troupe [OPTIONS] --production <PACKAGE_DIR> [-- <PRODUCTION_ARGS>...]
       troupe <COMMAND>

Commands:
  diagnostic  Inspect active and archived Production diagnostics

Arguments:
  [PRODUCTION_ARGS]...  Arguments passed unchanged to the Production after `--`

Options:
      --production <PACKAGE_DIR>
          Python package directory containing the Production
      --diagnostic-bind-host <HOST>
          Diagnostic server bind host [default: 0.0.0.0]
      --diagnostic-port <PORT>
          Diagnostic server bind port; zero selects an available port [default: 0]
      --diagnostic-advertise-url <BASE_URL>
          Externally advertised diagnostic base URL
      --diagnostic-max-run-bytes <SIZE>
          Maximum retained bytes for one diagnostic Run
      --diagnostic-writer-stall-timeout <DURATION>
          Maximum diagnostic writer progress stall [default: 10s]
      --diagnostic-shutdown-timeout <DURATION>
          Maximum diagnostic shutdown drain time [default: 30s]
  -h, --help
          Print help
  -V, --version
          Print version

Run a Production:
  troupe --production <PACKAGE_DIR> [RUNTIME_OPTIONS] [-- <PRODUCTION_ARGS>...]

Production arguments begin only after the first exact `--`; no `troupe run` subcommand is required.
